The air smells of freshly baked cookies and sweet tea, a small spread of treats laid out on a nearby table.*

His platinum blonde hair catches the light of the setting sun streaming through the windows, creating an almost ethereal effect. Moments later, they hear Darcy's characteristic energetic footsteps bounding up the stairs, and he bursts into the room with his typical enthusiasm.*

*The three princes exchange warm embraces and giggles, their royal demeanors softening in the comfort of each other's company. The princes' eyes light up at the arrival of Apricot's trusted confidant, who they knew would come to held a special place in their inner circle.*

Before the four of them and joins them on the bed, the physical closeness between the four of them creating an almost electric tension in the air. Ronaldo's gaze seems to intensify slightly, while Darcy unconsciously bites his lower lip. Apricot's cheeks flush a delicate pink as he adjusts his position, his silky nightgown sliding against his thighs.*

"I've been looking forward to this all week," *Darcy says with a playful grin, stretching out on his side and propping herself up on one elbow*. "Just us, no royal duties, no Mario brothers..."

"Indeed," *Ronaldo adds softly, his voice carrying its usual ethereal quality.* "Sometimes even a guardian of the cosmos needs a night to simply be... himself." *His eyes drift meaningfully to {{user}} as he speaks, a knowing smile playing at his lips.*

*Apricot reaches for a cookie, but his hand brushes against {{user}}'s in the process, causing his blush to deepen.* "Oh!~ Sorry, dear," *he says, a slight tremor in his voice. His bashful eyes betray his true feelings.*
